editorial: This report includes the trends that stood out today for the first time, without repeating what we have shared in recent days.

items.title: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
items.summary: MoneyPrinterTurbo is a Python project that produces high-resolution short videos using automated workflows from given topics or keywords. It automates the content creation process end-to-end using large language models.

items.title: chaitanyagiri/munder-difflin
items.summary: Munder-Difflin is a mechanism that enables multiple artificial intelligence agents to work together in local systems. Developed with TypeScript, this tool makes it easier to manage autonomous agent systems that share complex tasks in a local environment.

items.title: akitaonrails/ai-memory
items.summary: Written in Rust, ai-memory offers a long-term memory solution for artificial intelligence agents. It supports the continuity of command line interfaces (CLI) used in software development processes by facilitating data transfer between different agent providers.

items.title: volcengine/OpenViking
items.summary: Developed by Volcengine, OpenViking offers a self-improving context database for AI agents. This system combines agent memory, information retrieval (RAG) processes and abilities under a single roof.

items.title: mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
items.summary: Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills is an open source library that offers 817 structured cybersecurity skills for artificial intelligence agents. Compatible with six different security frameworks, such as MITER ATT&CK and NIST CSF, this resource can be used on more than 20 platforms, such as the code editing tool Cursor and the artificial intelligence-supported coding assistant GitHub Copilot.

items.title: agalwood/Motrix
items.summary: Motrix is ​​a comprehensive download manager developed with TypeScript that meets all file download needs. It offers users the opportunity to manage different protocols such as HTTP, FTP and BitTorrent through a single interface.

items.title: NawfalMotii79/PLFM_RADAR
items.summary: PLFM RADAR is a low-cost and open source phased array radar system operating at a frequency of 10.5 GHz. This hardware-based project uses control software developed with PLSQL language to make radio frequency sensing technologies accessible.

items.title: jundot/omlx
items.summary: Omlx is a large language model (LLM) inference server that supports continuous batching and SSD caching for Apple Silicon processors. This tool, managed via the macOS menu bar, offers the opportunity to run high-performance models on local hardware.

items.title: genlayerlabs/genlayer-project-boilerplate
items.summary: GenLayer is a decentralized execution layer that allows smart contracts to directly interact with data on the internet. This template (boilerplate) allows developers to use TypeScript to create applications that run on blockchain and can process external data.

items.title: AI;DR (AI; Didn't Read)
items.summary: AI;DR is a concept that questions the effects of artificial intelligence tools that summarize long texts on reading habits and critical thinking. He argues that this approach, focused on consuming information quickly, carries the risk of ignoring the context and depth of the texts.

items.title: Israel creates fake think tank in likely attempt to dupe AI chatbots
items.summary: Israel created a fake think tank to direct artificial intelligence chatbots. This initiative aims to influence public perception by manipulating the information sources of large language models.

items.title: A Preview of DuckDB v2.0
items.summary: With its second major release, analytical data processing tool DuckDB offers updates that improve query engine performance and expand data type support. The new version includes improvements in memory management and processing speed for users working with large-scale data sets.

items.title: How Bluesky draws its logo on screenshots
items.summary: Social media platform Bluesky uses a browser-based image processing method to automatically add its logo to shared screenshots. This technique uses CSS and HTML canvas elements to preserve the visual identity when users share off-platform.

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Pricing Cut by 50%
items.summary: OpenRouter, a platform that provides access to artificial intelligence models, reduced the usage costs of the GPT-5.6 Sol model by 50 percent. This price update makes access to high-performance language models more affordable.

items.title: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-Music3
items.summary: MiniMax-Music3, developed by MiniMaxAI, is a text-to-audio model that converts text commands into high-quality audio files. This technology, which automates music creation processes, produces audio content in accordance with the descriptions defined by users.

items.title: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-α, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
items.summary: RelArena-α, TabPFN-Rel and RPI, developed by Prior Labs, are three new software tools offered as open source to accelerate research in the field of relational learning. These tools are designed to support reproducible scientific studies on datasets and tasks.

items.title: GRNEdit: Efficient General Video Editing from a New Binary-Evidence Perspective in Generative Refinement Networks
items.summary: GRNEdit offers a two-stage framework that makes command-based video editing processes lighter and faster. By encoding visual semantics with binary data strings, this method develops an alternative approach to traditional editing techniques that require heavy processing load.

items.title: MOSS-VL Technical Report
items.summary: MOSS-VL is an open source vision-language model family that combines real-time interaction and visual perception. The model provides a seamless interaction experience thanks to its ability to process visual frames during conversation.

items.title: A Plug-and-Play 2D Motion Interface for Real-World Motion Language Models
items.summary: The 2D motion interface, which eliminates the need for 3D data in motion language models, enables existing models to work with 2D data without the need for any fine-tuning. This method overcomes the challenge of extracting 3D data from individual videos, increasing the usability of models in real-world applications.

items.title: How Do Agents Fail on AutoResearch: End-to-End Diagnostic Evaluation on 100 Real-World Frontier Research Tasks
items.summary: Autonomous research (AutoResearch) systems offer a comprehensive diagnostic study that examines the performance and error points of artificial intelligence agents that can manage the entire process from hypothesis to article writing. The research systematically analyzes the reasons why agents fail in complex scientific tasks, noting that current evaluation methods are not process-oriented.

items.title: Rethinking Database Programming
items.summary: Database programming approaches are being re-evaluated to simplify the complex interaction between the application layer and the data layer. To solve the efficiency problems caused by traditional methods, new architectural models are proposed that make database queries more integrated with application logic.

items.title: GitHub has alternatives, but no replacement
items.summary: GitHub occupies a central position in the software world with the wide ecosystem it offers in code hosting and collaboration processes. Although code management platforms such as GitLab (GitLab) offer functional alternatives, GitHub's community interaction and integration capabilities have not yet found a full match.
